title: Electric Vehicle Chassis | EV Skateboard Platform
summary: Olympus Electric Vehicle Chassis. A ready-to-drive EV skateboard platform kit for commercial and custom vehicle builds. 400V architecture.
body_markdown:
## Modular EV Platform Architecture


The Olympus **electric chassis** utilizes a modular architecture. Wheelbase adjusts from 183" to 196" for different vehicle segments without altering the core powertrain.


Fig. 1: Structural layout of the Olympus Electric Vehicle Chassis


## Integration for OEMs


The pre-engineered **EV skateboard platform** reduces development cycles by 24-36 months. Standard CAN bus protocols simplify integration with body electronics.


## Technical Specifications


Architecture


Skateboard / Structural Battery


System Voltage


400V nominal


Battery Capacity


42-54 kWh


Motor Output


130 kW (174 HP) continuous


Wheelbase Range


183-196 inches


Payload Capacity


3,550 lbs


Charging


DC Fast + Level 2 AC


Controls


Drive-by-wire (steer, brake, throttle)


## Documentation


CAD files, wiring diagrams, and integration guides available with purchase. Contact engineering for custom wheelbase configurations.
